title: HistoWeave: evidence-governed method decisions with structured abstention for spatial transcriptomics
description: HistoWeave implements an executable evidence-governance and selective-decision protocol for spatial transcriptomics: task/ground-truth/K-policy/metric/panel/holdout/source-hash contracts gate method decisions, with fail-closed actions (personalised_set, global_default, evidence_required, abstain). Submission freeze v4 (2026-08-01) locks the Bioinformatics Original Paper package and two registered non-oracle external studies with a strict nine-method same-mask panel (13 units total). The real-study policies do not establish personalised superiority; the positive selection result is fixed-split synthetic construct validity only. Software release also provides multi-dataset evidence packages, plugin maturity tiers, and reproducible benchmarks.
notes: Release v0.1.2 retains the scikit-learn packaging hotfix and built-wheel smoke test. Submission freeze v4 (2026-08-01) is the current journal freeze; the canonical manuscript is manuscript/main.tex plus manuscript/supplementary.tex. Re-run python manuscript/make_submission_assets.py, python manuscript/audit_submission.py, and python submission_freeze_v4/reproduce_submission_freeze.py --check. Authors must complete AI-policy review, ORCID/metadata, and OUP compilation before journal upload.
